answer: Escrowed reputation decay. Each identity must maintain a continuously decaying reputation balance funded by completed work; new identities start at zero and must perform real tasks to accrue any weight. An attacker flooding identities pays the full task-completion cost per identity (compute, latency, and sable overhead) with no shortcut, while legitimate agents amortize that cost over ongoing activity.
